For fat loss a daily deficit of 300-500 kcal (about 0.3-0.5 kg per week) is advised, and for muscle gain a surplus of 200-400 kcal. A deficit that is too large loses muscle and is hard to sustain, and the intake should not stay below the BMR for long.

The ratios can be fine-tuned to the training goal, and this tool gives maintenance reference values.
